Balance.name: Balance
Balance.description: A shockwave of pure energy descends upon the targets, they are stripped of lightning, fire, force, and ice resistance, or elemental resistance should they have any, HEA save to negate.

Celestial Alignment.name: Celestial Alignment
Celestial Alignment.description:
Caster touches a number of willing targets within one size category of themselves, and all of their bodies merge into one. This merger physically alters their body so that you appear as a mixed version of the participants. Affected targets decide what equipment is absorbed into the fused being and what equipment remains available for use. These fused items are restored once the spell ends. For the duration, the caster's body and that of all of the target's are effectively one and the same, and together they share one turn, though all except the caster lose their movement action. All fusees can communicate telepathically. All are aware of each other's surface thoughts, knowledge, or memories of each other, but can purposefully conceal anything not at the forefront of their consciousnesses. For the duration, targets: 
Have the combined maximum hit points/mana and remaining hit point/MUs of each fusee. 
Can make any attribute check, attack roll, or skill check using the highest available modifier. 
Can use all abilities and spells of the fusees, except for those they purposefully conceal from others. 
Individuals maintain their personal action sets and cannot make use of another's archetype 
At any time, fusees can use their reaction or swift action to end this spell early. When the spell ends: 
The targets reappear in an unoccupied space of the caster's choice within 5 feet of the fusion, and their bodies return to normal. If there is insufficient space, the targets are magically forced through whatever physical matter is blocking its reappearance in the shortest possible path to an open space, before reappearing in that space 
All equipment on each fusee that was absorbed in the transformation is returned to its original positions on its original owners. 
Remaining HP/mana are evenly split between all fusees up to their normal maximum. 
Any conditions, diseases, or similar effects that were afflicting the targets before the fusion are returned to them as appropriate. Any such effects gained during the fusion are retained only by the caster. 
Celestial Alignment consumes the focus of all involved, though they can continue casting focus spells if they are able to maintain more than one. Using this spell on an effigy does not count towards utilized focus.

Copycast.name: Copycast
Copycast.description: This spell is used as a reaction to an attempt to cast another spell. The caster copies the exact effects of the spell onto another target or point.

Displacement Orb.name: Displacement Orb
Displacement Orb.description: A glob of energy fires from the caster's fingertips, sapping the energy of everything around. Those impacted by the orb lose 2 + 1/4F d10 mana and have their focus disrupted, WIL save to negate. These mana can be recovered normally via a rest period.

Mind Meld.name: Mind Meld
Mind Meld.description: This ability allows the willing target to utilize any spells or skill that the caster has access to - though they must be cast with the target’s own mana. This spell affects both the caster and the target with the link, as the caster also has access to any spells that the target has. This consumes the target's focus as well.

Energy Conversion.name: Energy Conversion
Energy Conversion.description: Caster enhances a willing target with a layer of magical energy. The target has a placed roll on resistances checks/saves stemming from their choice of divine, fire, force, ice, Pure_Magic, or lightning damage types, 1/2F to select additional damage types. Should the associated check/save be made - the rolled damage is stored as a barrier for the target and they suffer no damage from the ability.

Energy Reset.name: Energy Reset
Energy Reset.description: An overwhelming rush of energy floods into the area, causing the duration of all active continuous and focus spells expires, WIL save to negate. The caster regains 1 mana for each individual spell that expires through the usage of Energy Reset, so long as the expired spells had a mana cost.

Energy Transfer.name: Energy Transfer
Energy Transfer.description: Caster's essence reaches out towards up to 3 + 1/F willing targets, re-distributing their magical energies as they see fit. Caster may freely rearrange the mana pools of the targets, though a single target's maximum mana cannot exceed their normal maximum.

Forcerush.name: Forcerush
Forcerush.description: As reaction to a target making an attack roll in the area, the caster may contest an attack roll in the target area 4 + 1/2F times. Should the caster roll higher, the attack is negated. This spell lasts until the start of the caster's next turn.

Halflight Lance.name: Halflight Lance
Halflight Lance.description: A beam of twilight flies forward, granting targets designated by the caster a 6 + 1/2F d12 barrier (that expires after 1 + 1/F minutes) and inflicting an equal amount of damage as Pure_Magic damage to targets not designated by the caster, HEA save for half.

Incantation.name: Incantation
Incantation.description: A thin barrier of energy surrounds the area around the caster. All incoming and outgoing ranged projectiles are converted into either force, fire, lightning or ice damage - determined at the casting of this spell. The damage type can be altered as a core action.

Life Transfer.name: Life Transfer
Life Transfer.description: Caster's essence reaches out towards up to 3 + 1/F willing targets, re-distributing their life energies as they see fit. Caster may freely rearrange the HP pools of the targets, though a single target's maximum HP cannot exceed their normal maximum. The caster must use the HP pools of the target and cannot transfer temporary barriers.

Link Vitality.name: Link Vitality
Link Vitality.description: Targets combine their HP pools into one, WIL check to negate. Should any linked targets take damage or receive healing, it is subtracted from or added to the shared HP pool. All fall unconscious and die at the same thresholds. At the conclusion of this spell they have their remaining HP distributed evenly. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Meld.name: Meld
Meld.description: A field of static surrounds the target, attempting to drain any active focus spells from them, WIL save to negate. All active focus spells on the target are dispelled, and melded into a single effect that is transferred to the caster. The caster maintains the focus for this single ability on themselves.

Prismatic Volley.name: Prismatic Volley
Prismatic Volley.description: Caster launches a flurry of prismatic bolts at the target area, making 3 + 1/2F ranged attack rolls. Targets take 3d8 Pure_Magic damage on hit or receive temporary hit points equal to the bolt's damage for 4 + 2/F rounds, as decided by the caster.

Shared Burden.name: Shared Burden
Shared Burden.description: Caster attempts to transfer any active conditions or abilities they or a willing target have onto another target, WIL save to negate if the target is unwilling.

Share Vision.name: Share Vision
Share Vision.description: Caster shares or forces their sight onto the targets, WIL save to negate. Affected targets lose their sight, and are only capable of seeing through the eyes of the caster. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Twilight Flurry.name: Twilight Flurry
Twilight Flurry.description: Caster makes a series of ranged attack rolls, firing (rank/2) arcs of multi-coloured rays from their fingertips inflicting 1d10 Pure_Magic damage to the target on hit.
